title: AetherPortalII
description: A Aether1 portal in the style of Aether 2
body:
Title: ☁️ Aether I portal, but make it Aether II

Before: Classic Aether I golden glow
After: Clean, celestial Aether II texture ✨

I swapped the original portal medium from the first Aether mod with the one from Aether II. Now your gateway to the skies looks more refined and ethereal – without losing that classic nostalgic feel.

(Just a visual change – no gameplay or performance impact.)
